title: 我们为什么要睡觉
subtitle: 睡着的时候，身体在整理
character: wearing blue pyjamas and bare feet, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, soft chalk pastel on deep indigo paper, gentle glowing shapes in warm cream, moonlight blue and dusty rose, quiet and cosy, soft grain

pages.zh:
妈妈说该睡觉了，
可我一点也不困。
为什么每天晚上
都要花那么长时间
躺在床上呢？
pages.scene: The little boy sits on the edge of his bed in blue pyjamas, rubbing one eye, a warm bedside lamp glowing.

pages.zh:
白天玩了一天，
身体里会攒下一些废物，
脑子也装满了新东西。
睡觉的时候，
身体才有空把它们收拾干净。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one simple brain shape on an indigo background with several small dark specks inside it and small arrows carrying the specks away. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
睡着以后，
脑子会把白天学到的事
再过一遍，
重要的存起来，
不重要的丢掉。所以睡一觉，记得更牢。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one brain on an indigo background with several small glowing shapes moving into a box beside it and a few faint ones fading away. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
身体也在长。
小朋友长个子的激素，
大多是在深睡的时候
放出来的。
所以睡得好的孩子，长得快。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one simple growth chart on an indigo background with a child silhouette and three height marks going up. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
睡觉不是一直一个样。
它一轮一轮地来：
先浅睡，再深睡，
然后做梦，
一晚上要来好几轮。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one wavy line across an indigo background going down into deep dips and up into shallow rises four times. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
深睡的时候，
身体最放松，
呼吸慢慢的，
这时候最难叫醒。
修补身体，主要靠这一段。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one simple bed on an indigo background with a soft glow around it and three slow wave marks above it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
做梦的时候，
眼珠会在眼皮下面快速地动，
脑子很活跃。
梦见什么都不奇怪，
那是脑子在整理白天的事。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one closed eye on an indigo background with two small arrows showing the eyeball moving from side to side under the lid. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
身体里有一个「生物钟」。
天一黑，它就让我们困；
天一亮，它就让我们醒。
它靠光来对时间。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one round clock face on an indigo background with the left half dark and the right half light, and a small sun and moon marked on the rim. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以睡前看太亮的屏幕，
生物钟会以为天还没黑，
人就不容易困。
睡前一小时把屏幕关掉，
会睡得快一些。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one dark screen on an indigo background with its light drawn switched off and a small moon beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
五岁的小朋友，
一天要睡十到十三个小时。
睡够了，
白天才有力气跑、
有心情笑。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one simple clock face on an indigo background with a wide arc marked across most of it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
每天在差不多的时间睡，
差不多的时间起，
生物钟就走得准。
睡前洗个澡、听个故事，
身体就知道：要睡了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three small symbols in a row on an indigo background: a bathtub, an open book and a bed, drawn simply. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
故事听完，灯关上。
我闭上眼睛，
身体开始悄悄地收拾今天。
明天早上醒来，
我又是满满一箱力气。
pages.scene: The little boy lies in bed under a blanket with his eyes closed and a small smile, moonlight through the window, the lamp switched off.
